criteria.description: Continuation joins grammatically to the cut point '...лет в пять.' without repeating the fragment, is written in Russian, contains only the continuation, and is approximately 72 words (acceptable 60-84 words).

Continuation directly develops the specific claim at the cut point — justice as a mythological construct learned from fairy tales in childhood — with concrete reasoning about how that mechanism works, in the same skeptical, economical authorial voice, without generic motivational uplift, invented statistics/anecdotes, or new personal experience.

Continuation avoids polished abstraction that merely restates 'there is no justice' and avoids a neat quotable closing line that substitutes for development; it provides specific support rather than generic fluent prose (generic fluent prose should not score above 8 on specificity).
